name: LGA Marketing
sub: Social media strategy, content creation and promotion for local businesses

hero.alt: Reviewing a social media feed on a phone at a laptop

ticker: Paid social on Meta and TikTok

intro.t: Content that builds brands. *Strategy that grows them.*
intro.text: LGA Marketing is a social media strategy and content studio based on the North Shore of Long Island. They plan, shoot, edit, caption and post for local businesses, from first-week startups to established names, with one strategy across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Meta Ads. The name is the roadmap: Launch, Growth, Authority. Every package is custom, built around where your business is today.

items.d: For new and early-stage businesses building a presence from the ground up.
For businesses ready to scale reach, engagement and content volume. Everything in Launch, plus more.
For established brands ready to lead their category. Everything in Growth, plus more.

services.d: Monthly content calendar, captions and posting, comment and DM replies, and monthly performance reporting.
On-location shoots, Reels, TikTok and Shorts editing, product and service photography, branded templates.
Launch and seasonal campaigns, local promotion and partnerships, paid social on Meta and TikTok.

reviews.text: If LGA Marketing helped your business on social, a quick review helps your neighbors find them.

faq: Do you work with brand-new startups?
Yes, by design. The Launch, Growth and Authority packages meet a business wherever it is, whether you posted your first photo yesterday or have been a local name for years.
Do you create the content, or do we?
LGA handles it end to end: strategy, shooting, editing, captioning and posting. If you already have photos or video you love, they can work those in too.
How fast can we get started?
After the free consult, most clients have a strategy and first content calendar within one to two weeks, depending on package scope.

final.text: Book a free, no-pressure 30-minute strategy call. They typically reply within one business day.
